meta.title: 如何解决「穿衣显胖，上镜显壮」
meta.title_en: How to Fix Looking Heavy in Clothes and Bulky on Camera

scenes.title_cn: 开场：这是今天我要拍的素人，我的朋友…
scenes.title_en: Opening: today's subject is my friend Winn…
sentences: 她目前的上镜状态和很多小伙伴一样，其实没啥大问题，但总觉得拍出来有些笨重。
Her on-camera look is like many people's—no real problems, but always a bit heavy.
a bit heavy（有些笨重）
不靠妆造不做爆改，还原自己最自然好看的瞬间。
Without styling or transformation, restore your most natural, beautiful moments.
natural moments（自然瞬间）
scenes.speak: Her on-camera look is like many people's—no real problems, but always a bit heavy. Without styling or transformation, restore your most natural, beautiful moments.

scenes.title_cn: 问题分析：为什么拍照容易显重感？一是…
scenes.title_en: Problem analysis: why do photos look heavy…
sentences: 为什么拍照容易显重感？一是体型偏胖，二是体格很大。
Why do photos look heavy? A heavier body, or simply a big frame.
heavy on camera（显重感）
身高1米78、体重150斤，在女生中绝对算超大体格。
At 178cm and 75kg, she's absolutely a big frame for a woman.
big frame（大体格）
翘皮灵动的摆姿做起来确实会有点压力。
Agile, playful poses feel stressful for her.
agile poses（灵动摆姿）
scenes.speak: Why do photos look heavy? A heavier body, or simply a big frame. At 178cm and 75kg, she's absolutely a big frame for a woman. Agile, playful poses feel stressful for her.

scenes.title_cn: 上镜优势：首先是身高臂展，带来了实实…
scenes.title_en: Advantages: first, her height and arm span…
sentences: 她的身高臂展带来了实实在在的优势。
Her height and arm span are real assets.
real assets（实在优势）
她属于梨形身材，重量集中在下肢。
She's pear-shaped—weight sits in the lower body.
pear-shaped（梨形身材）
面部非常平整，能扛住大多数光线效果。
Her even face can handle most lighting effects.
even face（平整面部）
scenes.speak: Her height and arm span are real assets. She's pear-shaped—weight sits in the lower body. Her even face can handle most lighting effects.

scenes.title_cn: 穿搭调整：身材高大或微胖的小伙伴拍照…
scenes.title_en: Outfit adjustments: tall or slightly heavy…
sentences: 深色系衣服可以在视觉上让整个人量感收缩。
Deep colors visually shrink your mass.
deep colors（深色系）
裙装比裤装更适合理型身材。
A skirt beats pants for a pear-shaped body.
skirt over pants（裙装优先）
面料不能软塌、不能贴在身上，整体保持一定宽松。
The fabric shouldn't be flimsy or cling; keep some ease.
keep some ease（保持宽松）
scenes.speak: Deep colors visually shrink your mass. A skirt beats pants for a pear-shaped body. The fabric shouldn't be flimsy or cling; keep some ease.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势与配件：夏天穿搭最容易暴露坠肉，…
scenes.title_en: Poses and props: summer outfits expose loo…
scenes.context: 舒展肢体+放大配件+室外背景。
sentences: 千万不要因为自己有肉就试图藏起来、收缩挤压，上镜会更显胖。
Never hide or squeeze your flesh—it makes you look bigger on camera.
don't squeeze（别挤压）
体格较大就不要刻意追求灵动感，以相对静态的动作为主。
A big frame shouldn't chase agile moves; favor static poses.
static poses（静态动作）
配件上不用小件，配包要选大一点的，避免变成参照物。
Skip small props and pick a larger bag—avoid size references.
larger bag（大一点的包）
scenes.speak: Never hide or squeeze your flesh—it makes you look bigger on camera. A big frame shouldn't chase agile moves; favor static poses. Skip small props and pick a larger bag—avoid size references.

scenes.title_cn: 光线与妆容：到这一步都是在强调收，但…
scenes.title_en: Light and makeup: everything so far is abo…
scenes.context: 平整面部放开光线+眉型微调。
sentences: 一味地收难免会有点呆板。
Restraint alone always looks a bit stiff.
restraint looks stiff（一味收呆板）
面部平整，光线运用可以放开一些，甚至尝试大光比。
With an even face, lighting can be freer—even high contrast.
high contrast（大光比）
眉毛走势有点低频，会让眉眼看起来不太精神。
Her low brow slant dulls the eyes.
low brow slant（眉型低频）
scenes.speak: Restraint alone always looks a bit stiff. With an even face, lighting can be freer—even high contrast. Her low brow slant dulls the eyes.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：有时候我们觉得自己很不上镜，是…
scenes.title_en: Wrap-up: we feel unphotogenic because we f…
scenes.context: 从模板中解放，扬长避短。
sentences: 我们把自己套进了上镜模板里，在和背道而驰的方向上努力。
We force ourselves into a template, working against ourselves.
the template trap（模板陷阱）
少羡慕他人，多欣赏自己。
Envy less, appreciate yourself more.
appreciate yourself（欣赏自己）
修饰短板，放大长处，保留特点，就是普通人上镜的根本秘诀。
Fix weaknesses, amplify strengths, keep character—that's the secret.
the secret（根本秘诀）
scenes.speak: We force ourselves into a template, working against ourselves. Envy less, appreciate yourself more. Fix weaknesses, amplify strengths, keep character—that's the secret.

practice: A heavy body or a big frame looks stocky.
Deep colors shrink mass; a skirt beats pants for pear shapes.
Keep limbs extended, never squeeze your flesh.
Skip small props; pick a larger bag.
An even face can handle high contrast.
pitfalls: Keep limbs extended—squeezing makes you look bigger.
收缩挤压显胖，肢体要舒展。
Keep some ease; the fabric shouldn't cling.
面料软塌贴身上会暴露体量。
Chase agile poses with a big frame.
大体格做灵动动作会不协调。
Use small props as size references.
Pick larger accessories and simple backgrounds.
小配件变参照物显笨拙。
Force yourself into the thin template.
Fix weaknesses, amplify strengths, keep character.
套模板努力会越走越累。
shifts: 用 heavy on camera（显重感）、big frame（大体格）、stocky（墩实）
用 deep colors（深色系）、shrink mass（量感收缩）、keep some ease（保持宽松）
用 static poses（静态动作）、size reference（参照物）、high contrast（大光比）
